title: Optimal Slice-Adaptive Tuning of Hybrid Slice Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.08172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Slice sampling is a Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm that draws its next state uniformly from a "slice"---a super-level set of the target density function---at each iteration, thereby providing automatic local adaptivity to the scale of the target. In practice the exact slice is not known, so general-purpose implementations use an approximate slice that is grown from a starting interval of length $w>0$, with a computational cost that depends on $w$. This work presents an analysis of the average per-iteration number of target density evaluations, as a function of $w$, of hybrid slice sampling with various slice-finding schemes for targets with contiguous slices. The paper uses the results of the analysis to develop automated, slice-adaptive tuning schemes along with suboptimality bounds and asymptotic convergence guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that the tuning schemes reliably yield near-optimal slice-adaptive tuning with essentia

translated_title: 混合切片采样的最优切片自适应调优
translated_abstract: 切片采样是一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法，它在每次迭代中从“切片”——即目标密度函数的超水平集——中均匀抽取下一个状态，从而提供对目标尺度的自动局部自适应性。在实践中，精确的切片是未知的，因此通用实现使用从长度为 $w>0$ 的初始区间扩展而来的近似切片，其计算成本取决于 $w$。本工作针对具有连续切片的目标，分析了采用各种切片寻找方案的混合切片采样每次迭代的平均目标密度评估次数（作为 $w$ 的函数）。论文利用分析结果开发了自动化的切片自适应调优方案，并给出了次优性界限和渐近收敛保证。仿真结果表明，这些调优方案能够可靠地产生接近最优的切片自适应调优效果。
tldr: 该论文分析了混合切片采样中切片宽度参数 $w$ 对每次迭代目标密度评估次数的影响，并据此提出了具有次优性界限和渐近收敛保证的自动化切片自适应调优方案。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the average per-iteration number of target density evaluations in hybrid slice sampling as a function of the slice width parameter $w$, and develops automated slice-adaptive tuning schemes with suboptimality bounds and asymptotic convergence guarantees.
